items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: But I had a fellow played with me by the name of Martin. I can recall now when I was playing piano he played saxophone with me.

ctx.x: But I had a fellow played with me by the name of Martin. I can recall now when I was playing piano he played saxophone with me. A fellow named Martin. And then right after he left me, he went with, oh, what is this fellow's name? He used to play Meyer Davis. Meyer Davis. Not Meyer Davis, but, well, it was Meyer Davis and this other name. He comes to Pensacola all the time. We went over to Mobile one time and he played over there.
Oh, let me see. Jan Garber? Jan Garber.
